title: 真题演练 · 情态动词推测
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 情态动词推测。

questions.q: He ___ be at home now. I'm not sure.
That ___ be Mary. She has gone to London.
questions.analysis: 她已去伦敦,现在不可能是她,用 can't。

questions.q: I hear someone knocking. It ___ be Tom.
questions.analysis: 听到敲门声,有把握的推测用 must。

questions.q: He ___ have finished the work; the light is still on.
questions.analysis: 灯还亮着说明没完成,否定推测用 can't have done。
may 用于请求许可,语气礼貌。

questions.q: 判断对错:She might can come tomorrow.
questions.analysis: 应改为:She might come tomorrow.。might 后不能再用 can,情态动词不连用。
